theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_st_lsc_local_graph
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (w₀ : Eucl (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ 1 h → IsOpen U → w₀ ∈ U → fderiv ℝ h w₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ (ψ : Eucl m → Eucl (m + 1)) (r : ℝ) (W : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ ∧ 0 < r ∧ IsOpen W ∧ w₀ ∈ W ∧ (∀ v v' : Eucl m, ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖ψ v - ψ v'‖) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Eucl m) r, ψ v ∈ U ∧ h (ψ v) = h w₀ ∧ fderiv ℝ h (ψ v) ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ w ∈ W, h w = h w₀ → ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Eucl m) r, ψ v = w
